text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH error rate detected in control-plane -> auth-proxy (5xx spike). Paging SRE oncall. Alert group: #oncall-sre, severity: P1

sre-oncall (A. Kim): I'm on it. grabbing console + routing table. Daniele / Mike, can you join?

danielle.infra (D. Lopez): oncall, looking at auth-proxy logs now. seeing a huge tail of `504` and `502` showing `org-lookup` timeouts.

mike.prod (M. Rao): noticing deploy churn? any recent config push to auth-proxy?

danielle.infra (D. Lopez): not from deploy-bot in last 30m. envoy upstream errors to org-svc: connection_timeout and 502s. stack traces show upstream timed out.

eli.support (E. Chen): customer tickets ~10 opened in last 5m saying "500 when creating spaces". support dashboard shows spike in new user requests failing.

eng-plumbing (T. Park): adding app metrics: 5xx rate = 7.9% over baseline 0.3%. p50 latency doubled. charts: https://dash.redwood/infraprod/controlplane/auth-proxy/errors (public link)

sre-oncall (A. Kim): quick checklist: 1) confirm origin (org-lookup / billing) 2) enable circuit-breaker to fallback cached org responses 3) raise replica count for org-svc 4) throttle bursty clients at gateway

danielle.infra (D. Lopez): confirmed origin: org-lookup. traceback: `org-svc` endpoints returning 504 behind our internal load balancer. sampling logs: 
```
[2026-06-12T17:12:03Z] auth-proxy -> org-lookup POST /v1/lookup 504 "upstream timeout" id=...
[2026-06-12T17:12:04Z] auth-proxy -> org-lookup GET /v1/org/123 502 "bad gateway" id=...
[2026-06-12T17:12:05Z] auth-proxy cache-miss org=123
```

mike.prod (M. Rao): can we temporarily bypass org-lookup for non-critical reads? we have a cached header `X-Org-Cache` that can serve stale metadata for 30s.

sre-oncall (A. Kim): good idea. Danielle - please push a config to auth-proxy to enable stale-cache fallback for reads only. Use rollout = canary 10% then 100% if stable.

danielle.infra (D. Lopez): doing it now. `kubectl -n controlplane set env deploy/auth-proxy ENABLE_CACHE_FALLBACK=true` then apply envoy route with `timeout: 500ms` and circuit-breaker. will do canary to two pods.

deploy-bot: deploy started by D. Lopez: auth-proxy v1.14.3 +-cache-fallback -> canary pods (2/12)

sre-oncall (A. Kim): also raising org-svc replicas. Danielle can you scale?

danielle.infra (D. Lopez): `kubectl -n controlplane scale deployment/org-svc --replicas=8` (was 3) — scaling now.

eng-plumbing (T. Park): adding a temporary LB rule to route 10% of traffic away from problematic AZ to healthy ones. doing `lbctl adjust --service org-svc --shift 10% az-east -> az-west`

mike.prod (M. Rao): adding gateway rate-limit to unauthenticated endpoints hitting org-lookup to limit blast radius: `ratelimit set auth-proxy /v1/* 100rps`

eli.support (E. Chen): customer impact summary for ops page: ~8% of API calls are 5xx over last 12m. Top affected flows: create-space, join-organization, new-user-join. Impacted customers: multiple early-stage accounts, some midmarket tenants reported session errors. Posting IDs to support board.

sre-oncall (A. Kim): logging mitigation steps: cache-fallback enabled (canary), org-svc scaled, LB shift + gateway rate-limit. monitoring for 15m before wider rollout.

[5m later]

danielle.infra (D. Lopez): canary looks good so far (errors down to 2.1% on canary pods). promoting to 100% rollout. `kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy` -> applying change to all pods now.

deploy-bot: rollout complete for auth-proxy v1.14.3: 12/12 pods ready

eng-plumbing (T. Park): LB shift reduced. org-svc latency returning to normal after scaling.

mike.prod (M. Rao): seeing 5xx drop to 0.6% cluster-wide in the last 4m. keep watching.

eli.support (E. Chen): support queue slowing, new tickets still trickling but declines. notifying top 3 affected customers via status page: https://status.redwood/incident/2468013579

sre-oncall (A. Kim): brief root cause hypothesis: sudden spike in org-lookup QPS (backfill job + retry storm) caused org-svc to exhaust connection pool -> upstream timeouts -> auth-proxy propagated as 5xx. We'll confirm after metrics & traces.

mike.prod (M. Rao): let's also check billing calls - if org-lookup timed out, some billing calls may have queued and created pressure.

danielle.infra (D. Lopez): confirmed billing is fine, low error rate. stack points at org-svc only.

next-oncall (R. Patel): taking next-2hr ownership for monitoring and postmortem. will collect traces and a replay of the spike. tagging Daniele and Mike for follow-up.

sre-oncall (A. Kim): handing off to @next-oncall. summary: mitigated with cache-fallback + scale + LB shift + gateway rate-limit. customer impact ~8% failures, now reduced. postmortem owner: @next-oncall.

next-oncall (R. Patel): acknowledged, I'll open a ticket (INC-2468013579) and start a timeline. preliminary action items: 1) add autoscale smoothing for org-svc 2) add connection-pool saturation alarms 3) introduce graceful retry/backoff in auth-proxy 4) run chaos test on org-svc to ensure resilience

eli.support (E. Chen): posted update to customers + status page note: "Mitigation applied, monitoring. Will follow up with root cause and next steps." :thumbsup:

eng-plumbing (T. Park): leaving pre-agg logs and trace links in the ticket. snippet for runbook: 
```bash
# quick fallback enable
kubectl -n controlplane set env deploy/auth-proxy ENABLE_CACHE_FALLBACK=true
# scale org-svc
kubectl -n controlplane scale deployment/org-svc --replicas=8
# rate limit at gateway
ratelimit set auth-proxy /v1/* 100rps
```

sre-oncall (A. Kim): good work team. I'll close the oncall page once next-oncall confirms stable for 30m. please don't delete logs — keep for postmortem. :white_check_mark:

next-oncall (R. Patel): will run a quick retrospective in #postmortems tomorrow. assigning RCA doc owner: R. Patel.

incident-bot: Incident 2468013579 status -> mitigated (monitoring).
